incident.body: Late at night, a major fire broke out at the “Taipei Life Home” residential complex on Leli 3rd Street in Keelung’s Anle District....

mask: Squad Leader Chan Neng-chieh handed his own oxygen mask to a trapped woman. It was his third time entering the fire during this rescue...
lastWords: But in the end, he never made it out.
victim: Chan Neng-chieh, squad leader of Keelung’s Ren’ai Squad, became the 46th firefighter to die in the line of duty in the past decade. Twenty-seven of them died fighting fires.
